2607.25169.title: CondPSE: A Polynomial-Filtered Structural Encoder with Conditional Modulation for Graphs
2607.25169.paper_summary: Message-passing graph neural networks are bounded by the 1-WL test and can miss topological structure that distinguishes non-isomorphic graphs. Positional and structural encodings (PSE) inject such topology-derived signals, and learned PSE encoders such as GPSE pretrain a single encoder to produce these signals from random node probes, which can then be frozen and reused as inputs across downstream graph models. We present CondPSE, a learned PSE encoder that applies a learnable polynomial graph filter bank to standard Gaussian node probes and refines the resulting structural-response branches through FiLM-style modulation conditioned on cross-filter, local message-passing, and graph-level signals. CondPSE is pretrained to reconstruct node-level positional/structural targets and graph-level invariants, and is then frozen for use as a downstream input encoding. On synthetic structural-discrimination benchmarks, CondPSE separates graph structures that 1-WL-bounded message passing cannot: it raises CSL accuracy from 42.9% to 97.3% and EXP accuracy from 68.3% to 99.9% relative to GPSE, and ablations show that the polynomial filter bank accounts for most of this gain. On real molecular property prediction, the picture is more limited. With a hybrid local-message-passing/global-attention backbone, CondPSE performs comparably to GPSE without surpassing it, and a ZINC backbone sweep shows no consistent ordering between the two encoders. We report these results and discuss why strong synthetic structural discrimination does not, on its own, yield a downstream advantage for frozen learned PSE encoders, including the role of downstream integration and possible mismatch between structural pretraining targets and molecular property labels.
2607.25169.paper_summary_zh: 訊息傳遞圖神經網絡受到 1-WL 測試的限制，可能會錯過區分非同構圖的拓撲結構。位置和結構編碼（PSE）注入這些基於拓撲的信號，而學習的 PSE 編碼器如 GPSE 預訓練單個編碼器，從隨機節點探針中生成這些信號，然後可以將其凍結並在下游圖模型中重複使用。 我們提出了 CondPSE，一個學習的 PSE 編碼器，將可學習的多項式圖濾波器庫應用於標準高斯節點探針，並通過基於交叉濾波、本地訊息傳遞和圖級信號的 FiLM 風格調制來細化結果的結構響應分支。 CondPSE 被預訓練以重建節點級位置/結構目標和圖級不變量，然後凍結以用作下游輸入編碼。在合成結構區分基準上，CondPSE 能夠分離 1-WL 限制的訊息傳遞無法分離的圖結構：它將 CSL 準確率從 42.9% 提高到 97.3%，將 EXP 準確率從 68.3% 提高到 99.9%，相對於 GPSE，而消融實驗顯示多項式濾波器庫佔據了大部分增益。在真實的分子性質預測中，情況則更為有限。使用混合的本地訊息傳遞/全局注意力骨幹，CondPSE 的表現與 GPSE 相當，但未超過它，而 ZINC 骨幹的掃描顯示兩個編碼器之間沒有一致的排序。我們報告這些結果並討論為什麼強大的合成結構區分本身並不會為凍結的學習 PSE 編碼器帶來下游優勢，包括下游整合的角色以及結構預訓練目標與分子性質標籤之間的可能不匹配。
